justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/FieldRegistry.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/FieldRegistryDefaultTest.java`. `FieldRegistry.Default` is compact and cohesive: it has one state field (`entries`), one public constructor, and only two public operations (`prepend` and `compile`), while the entry/compiled concerns are factored into nested helper classes (`Entry`, `Compiled`, and `Compiled.Entry`) rather than accumulating unrelated responsibilities in the outer class. The test class exercises one focused behavior set for field registration/lookup, which supports a single responsibility rather than insufficient modularization.
